How it works

1

Pick your game & pack

Choose the game, enter your in-game ID exactly as shown in your profile, and select a diamond / UC pack.

2

Pay with UPI

Place the order on WhatsApp and pay by UPI — PhonePe, GPay, Paytm or any UPI app. Keep your UTR / transaction ID handy.

3

Delivered to your ID

The pack is credited directly to your game ID, usually within 5 minutes of payment confirmation. No password needed at any step.

Store settings

Buyers see this name everywhere on the store, and every order is sent to your WhatsApp number.

Google Client ID: this store comes with a Client ID already filled in, so Google sign-in works out of the box. You can replace it with your own — create a free “Web application” OAuth client at console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Credentials, add this site's address as an authorised JavaScript origin, and paste your Client ID here. Clearing the field restores the built-in default. Email login keeps working either way.

How selling works

Buyers pick a game and pack, tap Place order, and WhatsApp opens with the full order — game, pack, price and game ID — already written. You reply with your UPI ID, confirm the payment, deliver the top-up to their ID, and mark the order done. Buyers can optionally log in (email or Google) so their name and email ride along with the order — a game password is never asked, ever.

Homepage banner

The big banner at the top of the store. Pick any game artwork already in the store, and edit the headline, text and button.

Trending deals (highlights)

The three highlight cards under Popular Games. Each card links to a game and shows that game's first pack price. Games ticked “Trending” in the Games tab lead the Popular Games row.

Games & packs editor

Add, edit or delete games and their packs — names, prices, MRP, bonus text, tags, cover artwork and the Zone ID requirement. Changes update the store grid, Popular row and order totals.

FAQ editor

Questions shown in the Questions section on the homepage.

Coupons

Buyers type a code in the top-up panel and the discount comes off the total before they order on WhatsApp. Codes work for this visit — share a code in chat or on your socials and it applies while this store session is live.

SEO

What search engines and link previews show for this store. The store name also appears in the header, footer and order messages.

Orders

Orders placed from this store in this visit. Full order details and payment follow-up stay in the WhatsApp chat with each buyer.

Bulk prices

Raise or lower every pack price in one go — e.g. −10 during a sale, or +5 when costs go up. MRP moves by the same percentage so the discount shown stays honest. Prices round to the nearest rupee and never drop below ₹1.
